answer: Joining requires an NFT held as collateral locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The network catches flooding the network with empty attestations through rate limits on signed messages. The penalty follows at once: half the bond is slashed and the rest frozen for ten epochs. Think of the bond as a pigment: locked, visible, forfeitable. Every harbor is audited against the bond registry each epoch. A velvet is what separates an agent from a thousand cheap fakes.
